chapter: C.L. Burke and Kid Ory years
title: Playing the Beverly Cavern with Ory
summary: He records with Ory for two years and plays six months at the Beverly Cavern, remembering Floyd Levin in the audience.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I was playing records with Ory, recording, for two years, ending with a six-month stand a the Beverly Cavern.
That was a club out on Beverly Boulevard?
They used to feature a lot of the dixieland bands in that club.
A lot of the college kids would go there, L.A. City College.
That's right. What's his name, a jazz fan, Floyd Levin?
They used to come there before they were married; they were just youngsters.
They're really well known as jazz lovers.
In the meantime I was working daytime with the board of education.
